name: collage
summary: Mixed-media magazine collage: real cut-outs of the people or products in the source photo and real brand logos, pasted as torn paper prints over a painted backdrop. Best for stories about a well-known person or a well-known company.
prompt: Mixed-media editorial collage backdrop: layered torn and cut paper, halftone dot textures, bold painted brush strokes, scraps of newsprint-like texture with no readable words, visible paper grain, like a Wired or New York Times Magazine collage cover, in a limited palette of the given colours plus neutrals.
